This vertical, rectangular editorial illustration features a red background. In the upper center, the word "TEMPO" appears in large, white, serif capital letters. Above it, smaller text reads "SIAPA BERDUSTA DI KAMPUNG PULO" on the left and "SBY: KESALAHAN PEMERINTAH YANG DULU KOK DICARI-CARI" on the right. Below the title, the date "31 AGUSTUS-6 SEPTEMBER 2015" is printed.

On the left, large yellow text with a distressed, stencil-like texture reads "SELAMAT DATANG BURUH CINA". Below, a man is depicted from the waist up, facing slightly right with his head tilted upward. He has tan skin, dark eyes, and short dark hair. He wears a grey newsboy cap, a white collared shirt with rolled-up sleeves, and grey denim overalls with metal buckles. His hands grip a large wooden-handled sledgehammer with a dark metal head, held horizontally across his body. 

In the bottom left corner, a white barcode box includes a price of "RP 39.500," the website "WWW.TEMPO.CO," and "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN." The man's posture is firm, his gaze directed towards the upper right. The overall composition uses a bold, graphic style with high contrast between the red, white, yellow, and grey elements.
